Implement the AWS S3 sink module for writing data directly to S3, reusing AWS SDK components from the AWS source module where possible, supporting configurable bucket, prefix, and file format, with unit/integration tests.

Develop the HAWQ sink module for writing data to HAWQ via PXF extensions, supporting Avro/Parquet format conversion, PXF client integration, configurable connection parameters, and unit/integration tests.
Implement the Solr sink module for full-text indexing and search, using the Solr Java client, supporting configurable Solr endpoint, document mapping, batch write options, and unit/integration tests.

Extend Spring Integration's error handling to support configurable global error channels, hierarchical exception catching (GlobalException, DefaultException, ModuleSpecificException), propagation of root cause exceptions as error payloads, and routing to the configured error channel for all source, processor, and sink modules (custom and out-of-the-box), with unit/integration tests.
